source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: OOB FRU-info variant; subsequent Read FRU Data consumes its size/access semantics but is separate coverage.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A 0x10 device 0 over lanplus; generic log clearing.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without error.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with schema-aware size/alignment/access-mode parsing.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Finds the read command but exposes credentials and accepts exit status only.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds exact response and FRU metadata validation.
historical_reviews.history: FRU reads/writes are separate cases; this query must not mutate inventory.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Review success is not a DUT PASS and credentials/logs remain protected.

original_test_intent: Read FRU inventory-area size and access mode for verified device 0 over OOB and validate the protocol response.
original_method: Master raw 0x0A 0x10 0 retained; execute through a secret-safe LANPlus wrapper.
manual_activity: Project supplies authorized BMC endpoint, secret reference and expected FRU-device mapping.
agent_execution_scope: Decode little-endian area size and access mode
engineer_actions: Approve device mapping and acceptance bounds

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Protocol command is relevant but -P leaks secrets and command success alone is insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe LANPlus raw 0x0A 0x10 0 and parse exact response fields.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate completion, exact payload length, little-endian area size, access granularity and device mapping.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Strengthens evidence and credential handling without changing the raw request.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not read or validate FRU contents.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A syntactically valid size may still belong to a misidentified device.

project_override_considerations: A vendor or Redfish inventory query is supplemental; it does not prove raw 0x0A/0x10 coverage unless protocol-equivalent evidence is approved.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master criterion accepts only command success and boilerplate clears logs; it omits response-field correctness required by the title.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and parser are deterministic after ordinary project inputs.

review_improvement: Converts transport success into semantic FRU-area validation and removes credential exposure.
independent_technical_reasoning: This command establishes the addressing limits for later FRU reads. A zero exit status cannot detect truncated payloads, wrong access granularity, byte-order mistakes, or the wrong device; those fields must be decoded before any consumer trusts the result.
